name: xcpane
description: Turns xcodebuild and swift build output into a live pane of errors grouped by file, and hands Claude the diagnostics instead of the raw log.

condense.title: Condense what Claude reads
condense.description: Replace the raw build log in the tool result Claude reads with the parsed errors, warning counts and test failures. The transcript keeps the raw output.

warnings.title: Warnings Claude reads
warnings.description: count: Claude reads how many warnings each file has. list: Claude reads every warning.

resultBundle.title: Add -resultBundlePath
resultBundle.description: Add -resultBundlePath to xcodebuild commands that name none, so diagnostics come from Xcode's result bundle and not from the log, which Claude Code cuts short on a failing build. The bundle goes to the temporary folder and is deleted once read.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane
autoOpen.description: always: when a build starts. failure: when a build fails. never: only on /xcpane.

compactRow.title: Compact transcript row
compactRow.description: Draw a build's result in the transcript as a verdict and its first errors instead of the raw log.
